kb_model_note: Derived offline from experiments/runs/kb-scope-v1-gpt-oss-120b (gpt-oss-120b via 9Router, temperature 0, norm-llm-v1, 07/11/2026, corpus scope v1 veaeaad4a6edc; main extraction model for corpus v1, decided 08/11 and 15/11/2026) with kb-materialize --validator kb-validator-v4 --inherit claims-inherit-v1 (23/11/2026); no model call. DK3 reads dk3.jsonl of that derivation: every claim, unvalidated, with empty actor, action and result slots filled from the parent's lead-in.
note: Main design for the lookup set on corpus v1, aligned with main-v3 on 23/11/2026 (docs/decisions.md 22/11 and 23/11). DK3 is DK2 plus the unvalidated knowledge base: the DK2 record of every unit with its claims from the lead-in-inherited KB (kb_model_note), claims_view thin, no index_keys (deterministic keys did not help, model-written keys missed their gate, 23/11), the reference graph as dk3.json. No amendment edges and no validity block: corpus v1 has no amendment edges.
